name: Óbidos

communes: Nossa Senhora Do Pópulo, Coto E São Gregório
Santa Maria, São Pedro E Sobral Da Lagoa

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Sémillon, Cabernet Franc, Tempranillo, Dolcetto and Merlot fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity.
soil.top: The topsoil drains fast and warms early in spring. Vines get little water, which keeps crops small and flavors concentrated, but drought bites hard. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Good for generous crops of standard to good wine.
